lines.spoken: A quarter to five, and the man in aisle twenty-two is eating kibble from the bag.
lines.caption: man in **aisle twenty-two**

lines.spoken: You shine your light on him. He doesn't run. "Hands up. Now."
lines.caption: **Hands up.** Now.

lines.spoken: He puts his hands up slow. "I hid at closing. Nowhere else to go."
lines.caption: hid at **closing**

lines.spoken: Ray. Hood up, staring at the floor. His hands won't stop shaking.
lines.caption: hands won't stop **shaking**

lines.spoken: Marcus kicks the fire exit. Snow hisses through the gap. "Every door's buried."
lines.caption: **Every door's buried**

lines.spoken: Dana checks the camera log. "Ten fifty-eight. He was inside before I locked up."
lines.caption: before I **locked up**

lines.spoken: "He's been in here all night, watching us," Marcus says. "He's starving," Dana snaps. "Let him eat."
lines.caption: **watching us**

lines.spoken: Afternoon. Every freezer alarm in the store starts screaming.
lines.caption: starts **screaming**

lines.spoken: Dana opens a freezer door. "It's soup in here. Warm fog rolling out."
lines.caption: soup in **here**

lines.spoken: Marcus stares outside. "The drift's colder than any freezer. Move it."
lines.caption: than any **freezer**

lines.spoken: Marcus hauls the bay door up. It stops at one foot of white.
lines.caption: one foot of **white**

lines.spoken: You shove the first pallet of frozen chicken into the drift.
lines.caption: frozen **chicken**

lines.spoken: By nightfall the drift is a tunnel of meat.
lines.caption: a tunnel of **meat**

lines.spoken: Day three. Six in the morning. The generator coughs twice and dies.
lines.caption: coughs twice and **dies**

lines.spoken: The lights die one by one. The store goes black.
lines.caption: store goes **black**

lines.spoken: Dana lifts the fuel can. "It's bone dry. Someone drained it."
lines.caption: Someone **drained it**

lines.spoken: "Three days of fuel, gone in two," Marcus says. Dana turns. "Who had the can?"
lines.caption: gone in **two**

lines.spoken: Four flashlights in the dark. Nobody speaks. Who took three days of fuel?
lines.caption: Who took three days of **fuel**
